description: Warsaw Bike-Sharing Daily Periods Graph Dataset for Graph Neural Network (GNN) - Season 2023 is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Igor Betkier. 1. Graph Structure and Attributes These data are represented as directed graphs (DiGraphs) where each station in the Warsaw bike-sharing system (BSS) is a node. Node attributes include coordinates (lat, lng), average bike availability (avg_bikes, avg_freeRacks), weather conditions (temp, precipitation, wind_speed), and distances to points of interest (d_city_cen, d_metro_st, etc.). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
